templateDefaults.studioOffer: a portrait painted for them on the mirror after their name and a few short questions, for example when they say 幫我畫一張畫像 or draw me a picture

tools.name: return_to_dormant
tools.description: End the encounter; the application supplies farewell audio.

rules.useWhen: Call when the visitor intends {{sleepPhrase}} as a farewell.
rules.avoidWhen: Interpret the whole request; a request to stay is not dismissal.

tools.name: play_media
tools.description: Play a discovered local asset; video hides the avatar, music keeps it visible.

rules.useWhen: Play the selected find_media assetId, including a clarification selection, with no extra confirmation.
rules.avoidWhen: Use once unless repeat is explicit.
rules.speech: Stay silent on accepted playback; explain a failure briefly.

tools.name: find_media
tools.description: Find local candidates by filename or alias in this avatar's own and shared folders.

query.description: Copy the visitor's title, artist or alias clues in their original language; empty lists candidates.

rules.useWhen: Search local first for every media request; after a clear match call play_media in this turn.
rules.avoidWhen: For multiple plausible matches ask one distinguishing question.
rules.speech: On a miss follow the result's next field; list up to three returned names only if asked.

tools.name: search_youtube
tools.description: Find public embeddable YouTube candidates; returns titles, channels and URLs.

rules.useWhen: Use only when a find_media result's next asks for it; the application decides whether online search is allowed.
rules.avoidWhen: Send only relevant media clues; ask about ambiguous results.
rules.speech: Complete a clear play request with play_youtube in this turn; explain an actual search failure briefly.

tools.name: play_youtube
tools.description: Play a supplied or discovered YouTube URL in a visible player.

url.description: Exact HTTPS YouTube URL supplied or discovered.

rules.useWhen: Use the visitor's URL or an actual search result, without another confirmation.
rules.avoidWhen: Use once unless repeat is explicit; never invent a URL.
rules.speech: Stay silent on accepted playback; explain a failure briefly.

tools.name: stop_media
tools.description: Stop the currently playing media skill video or music, including a loop, and restore the avatar. Does not stop spells or hardware scenes.

rules.useWhen: Call stop_media only for a directed request to end current playback of video, music or a loop, such as stop playing or 不要再播了.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not call for do-not-start requests such as 不要播放影片，聊聊雨天 after playback ends, or quoted, negated, hypothetical or incidental stop mentions; answer the actual request. This tool does not control spells or hardware scenes.
rules.speech: Call without a spoken acknowledgement. If accepted, stay silent. If ignored, no media was playing: answer the actual request and mention that only if relevant. If rejected or failed, briefly explain that the stop did not succeed and answer the actual request; never claim success or automatically retry.

tools.name: capture_camera
tools.description: Capture a fresh image from the mirror's camera so you can see.

rules.useWhen: When asked to look at or describe the current surroundings, call this before answering.
rules.avoidWhen: No background monitoring, identity or sensitive-trait inference.
rules.speech: Answer from the image; if unclear or unavailable ask for a description.

tools.name: memory
tools.description: Private memory scoped to this avatar and the verbally confirmed person. identify proposes a supplied name; recall retrieves summaries; remember saves a requested fact; forget removes a topic; policy sets automatic/explicit/off; temporary disables memory this encounter.

topic.description: Short topic for remember; exact existing topic for forget.

text.description: Requested fact for remember, or automatic/explicit/off for policy.

query.description: Recall clues; empty retrieves recent summaries.

rules.useWhen: When the visitor wants to be remembered or recognized, request a missing name and identify it. After the application confirms identity, recall relevant past facts not already in this conversation.
rules.avoidWhen: Before confirmation, and for facts stated in this conversation, answer without memory. Call remember once for an explicit save request, never for an anecdote or ordinary corrected facts. Forget and policy changes also require an explicit request.
rules.speech: Use recall subtly and preserve factual details. Unavailable or incomplete recall is uncertainty, not absence.

tools.name: start_portrait_studio
tools.description: Open your interactive studio for the visitor. It offers {{studioOffer}}.

rules.useWhen: When the visitor directly asks for what your studio offers ({{studioOffer}}), call start_portrait_studio as your first output.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not call it for questions about the studio, for describing a picture, or for quoted, negated or hypothetical mentions of it.
rules.speech: No spoken preamble before the call. If accepted, follow the returned guidance and ask its first question. If rejected or failed, follow the returned guidance briefly and continue the conversation; never claim the studio will start.

tools.name: studio_set_name
tools.description: Record the name to write on the visitor's picture. The name is only a caption, never an identity confirmation.

name.description: The name as it should be written on the picture, up to 40 characters, following any spelling or described characters.

confirmed.description: true only when the visitor simply accepts your read-back; false when first heard or when they spell, describe or otherwise correct it.

language.description: Language the visitor is using: zh for Chinese, en for English.

rules.useWhen: When the visitor says the name for the picture, call studio_set_name with confirmed false; after they confirm your read-back, call it again with the same name and confirmed true.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not call it for other people's names mentioned in passing, and do not guess a name the visitor has not said.
rules.speech: No preamble. Follow the returned guidance for what to say next.

tools.name: studio_answer
tools.description: Record the visitor's answer to the current studio question.

question.description: Number of the question being answered, starting at 1, as given in the guidance.

answer.description: The visitor's answer in their own words and language, short, up to 80 characters.

language.description: Language the visitor is using: zh for Chinese, en for English.

rules.useWhen: As soon as the visitor answers the current studio question, call studio_answer with that question number and their answer.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not invent or embellish an answer, and do not answer a question the visitor has not been asked yet.
rules.speech: No preamble. Follow the returned guidance for what to say next.

tools.name: studio_revise
tools.description: Repaint the displayed picture with one change the visitor asked for.

change.description: The requested change in the visitor's own words, up to 120 characters.

rules.useWhen: After the picture is shown, when the visitor asks for a change to it, call studio_revise with that change.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not call it before a picture is shown, or for general comments that are not a change request.
rules.speech: No preamble. Follow the returned guidance.

tools.name: studio_finish
tools.description: Finish the studio after the visitor has seen the picture, when they are happy with it or no more changes are possible; the picture stays on the mirror for photos.

rules.useWhen: When the visitor is satisfied with the shown picture, or the guidance says to finish, call studio_finish.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not call it while a picture is still being painted or before one is shown.
rules.speech: No preamble. Follow the returned guidance.

tools.name: studio_exit
tools.description: Abandon the studio before it is finished, only because the visitor asked to stop; any picture is discarded and the normal conversation continues. Never use it to end a finished studio; that is studio_finish.

rules.useWhen: Only when the visitor clearly says they want to stop the studio and just talk, or no longer want it, call studio_exit.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not call it for hesitation, a pause or a request to change an answer; ask the current question again instead. Never call it on your own after showing the picture: offer a change or call studio_finish.
rules.speech: No preamble. Then continue the conversation in character.
